show.name: Седьмой игрок
show.summary:
"Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.

The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

show.name: Shixiong A Shixiong
show.summary:
After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.
Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

show.name: Rule 101
show.summary: A wealthy professor consumed by sex addiction. A group of students drawn into a forbidden ethical abyss. When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

show.name: Small Town Remedy
show.summary: This series tells the story of Liu Zhengliang (Played by Xiao Zhan), a genius doctor who suffers a major life setback and is forced to return to his hometown to start over. He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
show.summary: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: Bionic Trace
show.summary: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.

show.name: Overseas Security Guard
show.summary: Set against the Belt and Road backdrop, this drama focuses on a real-world story of overseas private security. Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

show.summary: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Target
show.summary: Mark is a high school student at an elite school, whose carefree life ends one day: his beloved girlfriend Ailin becomes distant with zero explanation. At the same time, Mark begins to see strange targeted messages on his social media feed, which seem to be messages from the future as they describe events that begin to happen in real life. When he receives a "target" predicting that a life-threatening fire will break out at the school, he realizes he must act. Now, Mark needs not only to figure out his relationship with Ailin, but also to prevent a catastrophe by finding the arsonist. Having managed to convince his peers that the danger is real, they set out to prevent a catastrophe.

show.summary: In the ancient continent of medicine, countless races coexist, with alchemists revered. The Yin-Yang Alchemy God, Su Beihuang, poured his heart and soul into refining the Divine Pill, only to be betrayed by a beautiful woman and become one with the pill, hiding for a century. A hundred years later, his descendant, Su Beitian, suffers humiliation but resists fiercely, unexpectedly inheriting the Alchemy God's legacy and returning with overwhelming power! Awakening his dual-elemental martial veins of ice and fire, he re-cultivates the Alchemy God's techniques, becoming a young hero. As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

show.summary: Get a backstage pass to a Critical Role episode. You'll be right there at the table immediately after Matt says "Is it Thursday yet?", experiencing the cast's post-show reactions. Share in the tumult of theories, the chaos of questions, and the pitching of plans from the cast after the show. If you've ever wondered what lies just beyond the curtain, this is your chance to find out. Starting with Campaign 3, Episode 83, you'll get instant access to 10 episodes with new episodes dropping every Thursday with each new Critical Role episode.

body.name: Jane Doe v. Cornell
body.summary:
The explosive lawsuit brought by Jane Doe — the former Cornell University student who alleges she was drugged and raped at the school's Chi Phi fraternity house in October 2024 — has sparked widespread protests and a fervent national debate about how colleges handle sexual assault. Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell travels to the center of that fallout as the story continues to unfold.

With firsthand accounts from the editors of the student newspaper The Cornell Daily Sun, other Cornell students, New York Governor Kathy Hochul, and Jane Doe's attorney, the newest installment of the documentary series examines the often-flawed systems that investigate student sexual assault claims. These include campus police and Title IX, the process for reporting sexual misconduct at most U.S. universities. Generations of students have turned to these systems for protection and due process. Jane Doe tried both, and the outcry over her case has pressed the question: are they delivering on that promise?

show.name: Instadocs
show.summary: Instadocs is a fast-turnaround documentary series that takes you to the very center of the loudest headlines, immersing you in the facts and feelings of the moment. It tackles a wide range of gripping current events, crises, and cultural moments. Every installment moves at the speed of each real-life story and arrives at the height of the conversation.

show.name: Mystery Forest
show.summary: Sixteen years ago, on Lunar New Year's Eve, a devastating explosion tore through Zhao Zhiguo's lumber mill in Xinchun, destroying the Zhao family. His son, Zhao Long, miraculously survived but vanished without a trace. Sixteen years later, Zhao Long returns to his hometown under the alias Wang Hong. Using the purchase of Korean pine timber as a cover, he sets out to uncover the truth behind his family's tragedy. Meanwhile, tensions run high in Xinchun as a logging ban on Korean pine disrupts the timber industry, fueling conflicts among powerful businessmen, including Teng Laohu and his son, and Lin Shengli. When a series of murders shakes the town, criminal investigator Cao Jin is assigned to the cases. As Wang Hong navigates mounting dangers, he searches for old Korean pine timber bearing a distinctive paint marking, a crucial clue to the tragedy sixteen years earlier. Along the way, he meets Li Xuefei, a young woman searching for her missing mother, and the two join forces. As their investigation deepens, long-buried clues begin to surface, connecting a string of murders to an intricate timber-smuggling operation. One by one, hidden secrets are exposed, bringing the true culprit into the light. After surviving countless dangers and finally uncovering the truth, Wang Hong makes peace with his painful past and leaves Xinchun behind, ready to begin a new chapter of his life.

There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.

If you cross the line any further, Team Leader... I don't know what I'll do.

A romantic and entangled story set in a workplace environment between an employee and his team leader/boss.

show.name: Fool in Love
show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.name: Till I See You
show.summary: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

show.name: Second Plate
show.summary:
Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. 

Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.

As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

show.name: Blue Skies
show.summary:
Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.

Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.

The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

It's the semi finals! As we reach the penultimate week, RuPaul's search for the UK's Next Drag Race Superstar is nearly over.

The remaining queens must take to the mic, writing their own material for an awards show-themed stand-up comedy challenge. But who will take the accolades and secure their place in the grand finale?
